# storage-compact - context for bug hunters

Scope: storage/compact.rs, storage/block.rs, storage/params.rs, the decode side (codec/mod.rs:231-309)
and `scale_read_shape` / `ScaleWeight` / `calc_block_end` (util/mod.rs:413-522, 636-644). "NEW" = new
or changed since 6dbeb15 (#94 builder API + block clamping, #98 ReadContext to context.rs and
array/*.rs split, #100 read cache, #103 `Index`, #104 `OutBuf`). array-frontend.md covers compaction
and the read cache (context.rs, cache_id.rs); codec-archive.md the archive reader and filters.

## Purpose

- `BlockTable<S, ET>` (block.rs:77-92): 1-D table of independently compressed, always-full blocks;
  one 12-byte align-1 `BlockLocation {offset u64, len u32}` per block (block.rs:24-50), read in place
  from mmap. Backends `Owned`, `Borrowed`, `Mmap` (`MmapData` = Arc<Mmap> + ptr/len, block.rs:444-454).
- `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase` (compact.rs:172-181) is the nd layer: nd-blocks in row-major grid
  order; `read_data` (compact.rs:236-249, NEW: read-cache wrapper) calls `read_data_uncached`
  (300-380), which calls `read_data_slow` (404-524). Wrappers `Compact` / `CompactBorrowed` / `CompactMmap`
  implement `ArrayStorage` by macro (compact.rs:99-156).
- `ArrayParams` (params.rs:86-93, consuming builder NEW #94) and `tune` (params.rs:282-414) pick and
  validate the block shape (auto from CPU caches via `scale_block_shape` / `block_len_heuristic`,
  455-517). `ArraySpec` / `ArraySpecOwned` / `ArraySpecDynamic` (557-661) carry block layout, read
  hints and (NEW) read-cache id sets through lazy views; `read_shape_heuristic` (799-820) drives
  `scale_read_shape` (util/mod.rs:464-522).

## Contracts

Provided:
- `read_data(index, ctx, out) -> Result<()>` (compact.rs:236-377). Validation runs in
  `check_out_buf` (buf.rs:352-364) before anything else: `InvalidIndex` if `index.ndim() != ndim` or
  any `end > shape[d]` (check_get_range, error.rs:249-259); on 32-bit `InvalidShapeOperation` if the
  region's bytes exceed isize::MAX (check_region_size, error.rs:298-312); push only:
  `InvalidArgument` if `out` has the wrong stride count, is read-only, has strides that overlap over
  the region, or is shorter than the region span (check_out_buf_impl, buf.rs:384-431). So since
  K14/K103 the push dst span and no-aliasing ARE established locally by this check, not by the caller.
  `OutBuf` has only pub(crate) constructors (buf.rs:450-467): `read_data` is crate-internal (jix-py
  and users read through array/read.rs).
- `Index` (index.rs:10-20) guarantees ndim <= 8, equal lengths, every size >= 1 (stored as
  NonZeroUsize) and no `start + size` overflow. NEW: the old `nitems == 0` early return is gone;
  compact.rs:311 only `debug_assert`s non-empty. Consequence: an empty array cannot be read through
  `read_data` at all (every Index fails check_get_range); callers must special-case empty regions.
  `Index::new_unchecked` (index.rs:44-49, unsafe) callers own that invariant.
- Pull (`OutBuf::pull`): the slot gets a fresh pool buffer from `alloc_out_buf` (buf.rs:434-447) laid
  out in `read_layout_order`, always C order for Compact (ArraySpecOwned::new, params.rs:643), so the
  result is packed row-major. NEW (#100): if this storage's id is in the current scope's
  `arrays_to_cache`, the result is converted to a read-only `Shared` buffer (context.rs:211-224) and
  a later pull of the same (id, start, size) returns the same buffer (context.rs:181-193). Do not
  assume a pull result is writable.
- Push (`OutBuf::push`): writes exactly the region's elements at `out`'s strides, gap bytes untouched
  (tests compact.rs:545-630, 837-869); returns `Ok(())`. A push read of a cached region copies the
  cached buffer into `out` after `check_out_buf_impl` (context.rs:188-192); push reads never populate
  the cache (context.rs:205-207).
- Errors from a block read: `InvalidBufferSize` if the dst is not `block_size * itemsize` bytes
  (block.rs:197-203), `InvalidArchive` if the location is outside `block_data` (block_bytes,
  block.rs:161-172, checked on every access since K149) or the decoded size differs
  (codec/mod.rs:295-299, checked BEFORE filters run, K1/K17), `CodecError` from zstd.
- `spec().block_shape()` IS the geometry `read_data` uses (compact.rs:227-229, 324). Its equality with
  the BlockTable (`prod == blocks.block_size`, grid product == `nblocks`) is only `debug_assert`ed in
  `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase::new` (compact.rs:203-214). `flags().is_compact()` set (compact.rs:198),
  `element_cost` forced to 8.0 (207-208), own `ArrayCacheId` added to the spec (222-223, NEW).
  `as_compact()` always `Some`, shares `cache_id` and a clone of the spec (142-150, NEW: cache_id);
  `element_type_change` keeps `cache_id` (382-395).
- `read_block(idx, ..)` (block.rs:188-208) panics if `idx >= blocks_loc.len()` (block.rs:155).
- `ArrayParams::tune` (params.rs:282-414) on `Ok`: ndim <= 8; itemsize > 0; `check_shape_overflow`
  (dims <= i64::MAX, zeros-as-1 byte product fits u64); `block_shape.len() == ndim`; every
  `1 <= b[d] <= max(shape[d], 1)`; block bytes <= `BLOCK_SIZE_BYTES_MAX` = 2^30 (lib.rs:432,
  params.rs:368-378), so the block volume fits `BlockSize` (u32) and usize on 32-bit; shape padded
  to the block shape has a u64 product (418-427); `block_size >= 1`; `read_size.min >= 1`,
  `max >= min` (ReadSize::new, 28-32). NOT bounded: `nblocks` vs usize, `read_size` (user value,
  uncapped). `into_spec` (519-552) re-tunes and re-asserts with `assert!` (panics, not errors).
- NEW (#94): `tune` CLAMPS each block dim to `max(shape[d], 1)` (params.rs:331-334) instead of
  rejecting it; after the clamp only `b > 0` can fail the fixed-dim check at 375-383.
- `read_shape_heuristic` (params.rs:758-779): tile dims all >= 1; each either `<= max_shape[d]` or
  snapped to `max(array_shape[d], 1)` (util/mod.rs:517-521). Callers clip with
  `NdIterExtBlockOffsetSize` (array/read.rs:526-537, ops/reduction/common.rs:426).

Relied on:
- `NdCopier::copy` (util/nd_copy.rs:46-56): both ranges cover
  `sum_d (shape[d]-1)*stride[d] + itemsize`, src/dst do not overlap, dtype matches `new`.
- `NdIterExtBlockOffsetSize` (util/iter/block.rs:5-31): per visited block
  `inner_offset[d] + size[d] <= block_shape[d]`, union of active extents == `[begin, end)`, interior
  blocks full. `with_logical_global_index_ext` (util/iter/nd.rs:483) yields the row-major index in
  `block_grid_shape`.
- `BufferPool::get` (util/buf_pool.rs:39-50): distinct, UNINITIALIZED buffers of >= size bytes.
  `Decoder::decode` (codec/mod.rs:251-308): writes exactly `dst.len()` bytes or errors; ping-pong
  parity at 278-295 (an even filter count decompresses straight into `dst`).
- `ElementType::from_dtype` (element_type.rs:25, 54, 91; trait sealed since K70) for
  `assert_unchecked_eq` in `decoder_config` (block.rs:229).
- Archive loading (archive/array.rs:445-569, archive/block.rs:308-426) checks before `new`: dims <=
  i64::MAX, `0 < b <= max(s,1)`, `block_size` in 1..=u32::MAX, `nitems % block_size == 0`,
  `blocks_loc.len() == nblocks`, padded nitems / block_size / nblocks consistent (Strict also scans
  locations, block.rs:394-412); it tunes all-fixed, then installs the caller's fixed dims (566-581,
  K43). Mmap sections: archive `len` (common.rs:264-274) AND mapping len + alignment (block.rs:485-507).
- Compaction: `inherit_unset_from_storage` + `tune` (array/compact.rs:177-178) build the blocks, then
  `new` calls `into_spec`, which tunes AGAIN (compact.rs:195, params.rs:487); compact_ndarray_with
  tunes first too (array/construct.rs:110). `tune` must be idempotent for equal (shape, dtype); nothing in release
  re-checks the spec against the built blocks.

Unsafe fns / preconditions:
- `OwnedBlockTableBuilder::into_table` (block.rs:295-306): `unsafe fn`, no `# Safety`, no unsafe ops.
  Implicit contract "every block written once"; unwritten lanes stay `(0, 0)` and decode to an
  error (empty frame fails the size check), so it is vestigial. Only caller array/compact.rs:100.
- `SendSyncPtr::new` (util/mod.rs:530): no doc; callers (archive/block.rs:512, storage/plain.rs:178)
  must keep the pointee alive and immutable while the struct lives.
- `Array::read_from_file_mmap` (archive/array.rs:225, pub unsafe): precondition is only "file not
  modified (or truncated) while mapped" (docs at archive/array.rs:194-195).

## Unsafe inventory

- compact.rs:438 `get_unchecked(active_start..)` and 443-452 `copier.copy` (single block): src span
  local (one block touched means `start % b + size <= b`); dst span = the region of `out`, established
  by check_out_buf in the same call (push) or `alloc_out_buf` (pull). No-overlap: tmp_buf is a fresh
  pool buffer and `out` an exclusive `&mut` - relies on buf_pool distinctness.
- compact.rs:504 / 508 `get_unchecked(active_start..)` / `get_unchecked_mut(out_start..)` and
  510-519 per-block `copier.copy`: NON-LOCAL - src span from the ext invariant (iter/block.rs), dst
  span from block positions lying inside the validated region.
- compact.rs:493 `&mut buf[out_start..out_start + full_buf_len]` (direct decode): checked slice, but
  its CORRECTNESS rests on the `read_into_out` / `direct` reasoning at 459-467, 494.
- block.rs:229 `assert_unchecked_eq!` (util/mod.rs:540-546 = debug_assert + `assert_unchecked`): UB if
  `element_type.dtype() != decoder_config.dtype`. Established in `new` (block.rs:126) and
  `element_type_change` (240) via `from_dtype`. Only reader: archive write path archive/block.rs:82.
  Fields are `pub(crate)`/private; nothing mutates `decoder_config.dtype` (re-check).
- block.rs:388-395 `set_len` over uninit capacity, then `&mut [u8]` over it given to zstd
  (`build_from_data`, test-only callers: block.rs tests, array/mod.rs:418).
- block.rs:449-454 `MmapData::as_ref` `slice::from_raw_parts(ptr, len)`: bounds and alignment
  established at archive/block.rs:486-508, lifetime by the `Arc<Mmap>` field. NOT established against
  the file shrinking after mapping (SIGBUS); covered by the unsafe precondition of
  read_from_file_mmap. Zero-length section of an empty mapping: pointer validity left to memmap2.
- util/mod.rs:526-527 `unsafe impl Send/Sync for SendSyncPtr<T>`, any T (fine for a read-only map).
- codec/mod.rs:285 `&mut *self.inner.get()` on `context.decompressor` (context.rs:53): relies on
  ReadContext being !Sync (UnsafeCell, RefCell fields) and `decode` not re-entering.
- Pool buffers expose uninit memory as `&mut [u8]` (buf_pool.rs:114, library-wide); a failed pull
  read leaves an uninit buffer in the slot, which `read_data_pull` drops.
- index.rs:44-49, 91-94: `transmute` to `NonZeroUsize` and `assert_unchecked` on lengths - NEW,
  relied on by compact.rs:310-322 (`index.size()`, `index.ndim()`).

## Edge-case surface

- Empty regions / zero-length dims: unrepresentable in `Index`; `tune` clamps a block dim on a
  0-length dim to 1 (params.rs:333; test params.rs:1767), grid len 0, `nblocks` 0; archive nitems 0
  (archive/array.rs:499-500).
- 0-d (shape []): `single_block_idx = Some(0)` (empty fold), aligned and contiguous (strides [] ==
  []), so fast path 1 reads block 0 of a 1-item table (compact.rs:344-354); `read_data_slow` is never
  reached for ndim 0 (its dispatch at 359-365 would send 0 to DimDyn). In `tune`,
  `DimBitmap::filled(0, _).all()` is vacuously true.
- Length-1 dims: fast path 1 uses exact `is_contiguous` (buf.rs:235-238), so an odd stride on a size-1
  out dim falls to the slow single-block path; `read_into_out` ignores strides of size-1 out dims
  (compact.rs:458-459; test compact.rs:761); check_out_buf_impl ignores len-1 dims (buf.rs:399).
- Out buffers: 0-stride / aliasing / too-short push outs are rejected (buf.rs:398-430; conservative,
  some interleaved non-overlapping layouts also fail). Permuted / F-order / padded strides take the
  slow path with direct decode disabled. Unaligned outs allowed (core_trait.rs:88-92; test
  compact.rs:796); decode is byte-level, but filters write into `dst` too (codec/mod.rs:302-305).
- Partial edge blocks and block shapes that do not divide the shape: blocks are stored zero-padded
  (array/compact.rs:297-304); the aligned fast path needs `end % b == 0`, so edge blocks always go
  through tmp_buf; `direct` needs every active extent == block_shape, so an edge block is never
  decoded into `out`; padding bytes (arbitrary in an untrusted file) are never copied out.
- ndim dispatch: 1-4 `Dim<N>`, 5-8 `DimDyn` (compact.rs:356-362); NDIM_MAX via Index (index.rs:53),
  `check_ndim` in tune / archive read, `DimArray` capacity.
- dtypes: only itemsize/alignment matter here (NdCopier routine by pair, nd_copy.rs:29-38; struct /
  inner-shape dtypes take `copy_untyped`); decoded bytes are never validated (bool8 accepts any byte).
- 32-bit (x86, armv7 wheels): region math bounded by check_region_size, block bytes by the 1 GiB
  cap. Left: `block_idx as usize` (block.rs:155), `nblocks as usize` / `block_index as usize` in
  `OwnedBlockTableBuilder` (block.rs:288, 318; tune bounds nitems to u64, not `nblocks` to usize).
  On 64-bit a huge `nblocks` (block [1] on a broadcast to [2^40]) makes `start` allocate 12 * nblocks
  bytes (abort, not an error).
- Integer edges, unchecked but bounded by callers: `nblocks * block_size` (block.rs:124), volume
  products (params.rs:423, util/mod.rs:488; check_shape_overflow), `block_len_heuristic` division by
  `inner_block_volume >= 1` (params.rs:450) and `next_multiple_of` (needs `dim_len <= i64::MAX`).
- NaN/inf: only in cost hints. `max_cost_layout_order` does `partial_cmp().unwrap()`
  (params.rs:979); costs are clamped to [0, 2^64] (params.rs:797, 850) but `f32::clamp(NaN)` is NaN.
  `ScaleWeight::new(NaN)` gives `Self(1)` (NaN fails both compares, util/mod.rs:422-430).
- Malformed / truncated mmap: truncated header = I/O error; out-of-range section or block location =
  InvalidArchive (location: at load under Strict, else on access); corrupt frame = CodecError or
  InvalidArchive; overlapping / duplicate locations are accepted; a block over 1 GiB fails in `tune`
  (InvalidArgument). Truncation AFTER mapping is UB/SIGBUS by contract.

## Intentional behaviors

- NEW (#94): a block dim larger than the array is CLAMPED to the array length, not rejected
  (params.rs:104-108 doc, 370-373; tests params.rs:1767, array/construct.rs:368). Reverses the
  behavior described by the previous version of this doc.
- An explicit `block_shape` is all-fixed by default, an auto one all-non-fixed (params.rs:112-112,
  141-144, 339-340; test params.rs:1738). `block_shape_fixed_dims` without `block_shape` is an error
  in `tune` (334-338; test 1820).
- Auto block shape and default `read_size` depend on the host CPU caches (params.rs:293, 351,
  439-446; float reductions can differ across machines, K150 open). Archives store the block shape.
- All blocks are full, edge blocks zero-padded (compact.rs:168-168, block.rs:52-57). `info()`
  reports "Compact" for all three wrappers (compact.rs:132-134).
- Blocks over 1 GiB are rejected (params.rs:368-378; test 1119); an inherited oversized block shape
  has its fixed dims cleared so `tune` rescales it, even when the caller set fixed dims
  (params.rs:248-251; test 1212; K105).
- `inherit_unset_from_storage` keeps a caller's `block_shape_fixed_dims` when `block_shape` is unset
  (params.rs:239-241; test 1105; K123). It inherits `block_size` bytes as-is even if the itemsize
  changed.
- Archive reads keep the file's block shape; the caller's fixed dims are only hints for later ops
  (archive/array.rs:552-567; test :711; K43); the read params' codec is used, not the file's (K148).
  `ArchiveValidation::Minimal` skips the location scan (archive/mod.rs:19-26); access still checks.
- `combine_block_layout`: per-dim max; a dim is fixed iff some input fixes it and every fixing input
  has the max (params.rs:987-1001; test 1584; K121). Scalar/Plain leaves do not override a compact
  operand's block shape (test 1599).
- `scale_read_shape` may return a tile larger than the request (snap, util/mod.rs:515-521);
  `ScaleWeight` never rounds a positive fraction to NONE (util/mod.rs:429; test params.rs:1154); ties
  in `max_cost_layout_order` go to the first input (test 1185); element cost clamped to [0, 2^64]
  (test 1226; K104).
- Read cache (NEW #100): repeated pull reads of a cached id return the same buffer (test
  compact.rs:888); push reads are never cached (1200); nested scopes hide the outer cache (1099, 1118).
- `ReadContext` is one-per-thread, !Sync (context.rs:21-21); byte- then bit-shuffle is allowed
  (codec/mod.rs:87-87).
- Stale comment, not a bug: test compact.rs:835-838 claims the slow path; fast path 1 is taken.

## Hot spots

NEW / changed since 6dbeb15 (concentrate here):
- NEW compact.rs:236-249 + context.rs:148-243: a hit skips `check_get_range` / `check_region_size`
  (push: only `check_out_buf_impl`). Safe only if every entry for the id came from a validated read of
  a same-shape, same-dtype storage. Storages sharing `cache_id`: as_compact (144), element_type_change
  (390), `&S`, ArrayStorageAny clones - can any differ in shape, dtype or itemsize?
- [RULED OUT in batch7-6 for 64-bit: every `Index::new_unchecked` reaching Compact is non-empty and in-shape (audited twice, with debug asserts live in every experiment)] NEW compact.rs:309-322: the `nitems == 0` early return became a `debug_assert`. Is every
  `Index::new_unchecked` that reaches Compact non-empty and in-shape (array/compact.rs:263-264,
  array/read.rs:553-554, reductions, shape ops)? A zero size would also be UB in index.rs:47.
- NEW params.rs:331-334 clamp: does clamping ever change the geometry of an EXISTING Compact (any path
  where `into_spec` sees a block shape the blocks were not built with)? Is `tune` still idempotent
  (compact_with tunes 2-3 times) for every mix of block_shape / fixed dims / block_size / read_size,
  including block_size 0, block_size < itemsize, ndim 0?
- NEW params.rs:826-908 cache-id sets: can a wrong `arrays_to_cache` cost correctness (only speed is
  acceptable)? Invariant `arrays_to_cache` subset of `arrays_to_cache_potentially` relies on
  debug_asserts at 909, 915.
- CHANGED codec/mod.rs:241-261, 319: Decoder borrows `context.decompressor` / `buffer_pool` fields
  directly (ReadContext moved). Can a second `&mut` to the decompressor exist during a decode?

Long-standing:
- Direct decode (compact.rs:456-464, 494-499): `lead_dim` = first dim with block > 1; requires out
  C-contiguous ignoring size-1 dims and `out_shape[d] == block_shape[d]` after lead_dim, plus a full
  block. Find a block/out shape (size-1 dims before and after lead_dim, all-ones block, ndim 5-8,
  out sub-tile passed by array/read.rs:550-555) where a full block is NOT one contiguous run.
- Three paths must agree: fast path 1 (347-357), single-block (430-454), general (469-521); test edge
  blocks, unaligned starts, size-1 dims, ndim 0 and 5-8.
- Geometry drift: spec block shape vs BlockTable for every constructor (compact_with, archive
  read_from, array/mod.rs:437, as_compact). Same volume, other shape ([4,2] vs [2,4]) = silent garbage.
- `tune` panics vs errors: `try_product().unwrap()` (params.rs:396), `try_into().unwrap()` (516),
  `into_spec` asserts (540-548), `ReadSize::nitems` divide (39, guarded by itemsize checks).
- Filters writing into an unaligned or odd caller `dst` (fast path 1 / direct decode): byte and bit
  shuffle decode (codec/filter.rs:40, codec/{byte,bit}_shuffle.rs) must be byte-safe.

### Suspicions (unverified)

- [CONFIRMED in batch7-2 as K160] block.rs:288, 318 - on 32-bit `nblocks as usize` / `block_index as usize` truncate; tune does not
  bound `nblocks` to usize, so compact_with of a > 2^32-block layout gets a short `blocks_loc` (likely
  a bounds panic instead of an error; check no ordering lets an index >= 2^32 alias a written slot).
- [INTENDED (K105) except the skipped length check: CONFIRMED in batch7-2 as K162] params.rs:248-251 - `inherit_unset_from_storage` replaces a caller-supplied `block_shape_fixed_dims`
  with all-false when the inherited block exceeds 1 GiB, silently overriding explicit user flags
  (maybe intended by K105; confirm against K123's "keeps the caller's fixed dims").
- [RULED OUT in batch7-2: vestigial unsafe, every block is written before it runs] block.rs:295 - `into_table` is an `unsafe fn` with no stated contract; decide whether anything
  still depends on it (unwritten blocks now fail with InvalidArchive).

## Review units

### storage-compact-read-path
Files: jix/src/storage/compact.rs:1-522, jix/src/storage/block.rs:1-458 (about 990 lines).
Consult: storage/buf.rs:350-515, storage/index.rs, context.rs:144-243, error.rs:192-312,
util/nd_copy.rs, util/iter/block.rs, util/iter/nd.rs, util/mod.rs (calc_block_end,
assert_unchecked_eq, SendSyncPtr), codec/mod.rs:231-309, util/buf_pool.rs, archive/array.rs:441-569,
archive/block.rs:300-515, array/compact.rs:85-336, array/read.rs:485-558 (all under jix/src).
Focus:
1. NEW: does the read-cache wrapper (compact.rs:236-249) ever serve a hit that an uncached read would
   have rejected or computed differently (shared cache_id via as_compact / element_type_change)?
2. NEW: with the empty-region early return removed (compact.rs:309-322), is every Index reaching
   Compact non-empty, and is ndim-0 handled entirely by fast path 1?
3. Is the `direct` condition (compact.rs:456-464, 494) sufficient for all block/out shapes?
4. Can out_start/active_start exceed the slices given to get_unchecked(_mut) (441, 507-508) or the
   NdCopier spans, for any valid Index and any out accepted by check_out_buf?
5. Do fast path 1, the single-block path and the general path agree on edge blocks of a block shape
   that does not divide the shape, unaligned starts, size-1 dims and ndim 5-8?
6. Is `prod(spec.block_shape) == blocks.block_size` (and the same shape) guaranteed for every
   constructor, given the repeated `tune` in compact_with?
7. Malformed / truncated mmap archives: any location, section or header value that panics, aborts
   or reads out of bounds instead of erroring (block.rs:155, 163-174, MmapData::as_ref)? And 32-bit
   truncation at block.rs:155, 199, 288, 318?

Focus:

   unchanged (archive read, compact_with's second tune)?

   that drops, overrides or mismatches the length of user-set fields?
3. NEW: cache-id merging (params.rs:826-908): can a missing or extra id break correctness, and do the
